turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Got some pain at the hip, but the meds help. Feeling a bit dizzy and nauseous though.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Okay, we can give you something for the nausea. Any trouble breathing or sore throat?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Throat's a bit sore, but breathing's fine.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's from the tube during anesthesia. Do you remember anything from the operation?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Not really, I was out cold.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's normal. Now, regarding your other conditions – how's your blood pressure, sugar levels, and kidneys?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: All seem okay. No issues so far.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Any discomfort from BPH or need to urinate?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Not really, but I'm a bit thirsty.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: We'll monitor your fluids and check your blood sugar and BP regularly. Rest well.
